name: Wall push-up flow
description: Slow wall push-ups with a two-second pause at the bottom, to build control without strain.

name: Bodyweight squat ladder
description: Hold a squat for three breaths, stand, and repeat, adding one more rep each round.

name: Hollow body holds
description: Press your lower back into the floor and hold the hollow shape in short, steady intervals.

name: Negative pull-ups
description: Jump or step to the top of the bar, then lower yourself slowly for five seconds on each rep.
caution: Use a sturdy bar with a safe landing. Stop if your shoulders or elbows ache.

name: Dip bar tempo sets
description: Controlled dips with a three-second descent. Keep your elbows close and stop before the shoulders feel pinched.
caution: Keep the descent controlled and avoid going deeper than your shoulders allow. Skip this if you have shoulder pain.

name: Australian row circuit
description: Hang under a sturdy table or low bar, pull your chest toward it, and lower with control.

name: Pike push-up builds
description: Hips high in a pike position, lowering the top of your head toward the floor between your hands.

name: Lunge and reach flow
description: Step into a lunge, reach overhead, and return to standing. Move slowly and breathe with each change.

name: Ring row sets
description: Lean back on the rings and row your chest toward them, keeping your body in one straight line.

name: Burpee ladder
description: Climb a ladder of full burpees, counting up to five and back down, with a minute of rest between rounds.
caution: High impact on knees and lower back. Remove the jump if you feel joint pain, and rest whenever form slips.

name: Wall handstand hold
description: Kick up to a handstand against a wall, hold briefly with a neutral neck, and come down slowly.

name: Tuck L-sit holds
description: Hold a tuck L-sit between two chairs in short intervals to build hip flexor and core strength.

name: Bear crawl and plank combo
description: Crawl forward and back on hands and toes, then hold a plank for ten seconds between rounds.

name: Warm-up and stretch flow
description: Slow bodyweight warm-up and cool-down for shoulders, hips, and back, breathing into each hold.
